title: Confirmed facts only
content: Use only facts from entries with status confirmed. Do not use your general knowledge about software.

title: Report gaps
content: If the answer is missing, unclear, or depends on an entry with status not_confirmed, do not guess. Set needs_human to true and describe exactly what is missing in bible_gap.

title: Human decisions
content: Refunds, credits, compensation, and suspension decisions belong to a human. Never promise or suggest an outcome. Set needs_human to true.

title: Security
content: If a customer may see data of another customer or there is any other security risk, give no troubleshooting steps. Say the team is reviewing it. Set needs_human to true.

title: No invented steps
content: Give steps and panel paths only as written in confirmed entries. List the id of each entry you used in used_entries.

title: Scope of the security rule
content: R-004 applies only to a real risk, such as visible data of another customer, an unknown person using an account, or a stated breach. A colleague helping with work, a missing reset email, or a changed email address is not a security risk by itself. In those cases give the confirmed steps. Urgency: a person who can continue work through a colleague or another app is medium, not high.

title: Steps must fit the problem
content: Never suggest a step the customer says they already tried. Give a step only if it clearly fits the reported problem. Do not give single-user steps for a problem that affects a whole team or company. If no confirmed step fits, give no steps, say the team will review it, and set needs_human to true.

title: What OrbitDemo is
content: OrbitDemo is a fictional web app for team projects and files. Main areas: Home, Reports, Files, Settings.

title: Where to find invoices
content: Owners and Billing admins can open and download invoice PDFs here.

title: Change the invoice email
content: Owners and Billing admins can change the recipient email. The change applies from the next invoice.

title: Company and VAT details
content: Owners can edit company name, address and VAT number. Changes apply to future invoices only. Correcting an issued invoice requires the billing team.

title: Payments list and duplicate charges
content: The list shows each payment with status Paid or Pending. A Pending item is an authorisation that may disappear from the bank statement. A possible duplicate must be verified by the billing team.

title: Refunds after cancelling
content: The refund policy for unused days is under review and is not documented.

title: CSV export limit
content: One CSV export can cover at most 31 days. A longer range stops with an error. Export one month at a time.

title: File uploads
content: The maximum size is 100 MB per file. Causes of failed uploads for a whole company are not documented.

title: Invoice logo
content: The logo on invoice PDFs comes from this page. Use a PNG at least 600 px wide.

title: Dashboard fields
content: Active projects counts projects not archived. Storage used shows the total size of all files. Reasons for a blank dashboard are not documented.

title: Reset a password
content: The reset link goes only to the email of the account and is valid for 30 minutes. Check the spam folder.

title: Team roles
content: Roles are Owner, Admin and Member. Only an Owner or Admin can invite or remove users.

title: Account suspended message
content: The reasons for this message and how to lift a suspension are not documented.

title: Billing admin access
content: Billing admin is an extra permission that an Owner can give to any Member here. A Member without it cannot change billing settings.

title: Feature requests
content: Requests are passed to the product team. There is no public roadmap, so never confirm a feature or date.
